symptom: MDL078 refused `Icon: glyph 9999` and `glyph 43` that Marketplace modules (ConversationalUI, TreeGraphWidgets) store, blocking the describe → exec round trip of those pages.
cause: glyphIcons was extracted from the private-use range of the font's cmap only (and from the stylesheet's `\eXXX` rules). Glyphicons Halflings also maps 11 named icons at ordinary code points (U+002A asterisk … U+270F pencil); mxbuild's GlyphFont table has them.
fix: Added the 11 codes the bundled Bootstrap stylesheet names outside the private-use range (with aliases eur, jpy, rub). Whitespace code points and U+25FC, also in the cmap but unnamed, stay out.
insight: 'The cmap's private-use range' was a scoping assumption written as a measurement. Read the whole cmap (27 non-PUA entries), then decide by deploy build ONE CODE PER BUILD: a batched page crashes on any single bad code and tells you nothing about the rest. Controls 57562 (crash) and 57377 (ok) prove the probe discriminates. Each build is ~25 s on the blank 11.12.6 project.
test: mdl/executor/glyph_codes_outside_pua_2112_test.go (11 accepted; control: whitespace codes still refused); TestGlyphIconsMatchTheFont now expects 258
